purpose: Measure patient-level generality of the selected-multi-anchor refinement after the frozen counterexample passed U1.

execution.selection_rule: For each patient, use the first dual-operation topology pass in frozen source order; stop on the first indeterminate source instead of skipping it.

failure_policy: Any source timeout, nonzero exit, missing receipt, or identity mismatch makes that patient indeterminate and stops later sources for that patient.
authorization_basis: Codex self-authorized a development-only rerun after 41 focused tests passed and the predeclared counterexample improved from 69,300 to 80,326 pixels with fresh preflight and whole-mask topology passage.
